signals.description: How high the right hand is (1 = top of the picture).
How high the left hand is (1 = top of the picture).
Left-to-right position of the right hand (0 = left edge).
Left-to-right position of the left hand (0 = left edge).
How far apart the two hands are (0 = touching, 1 = far apart).
Head tilt: 0 = tilted fully left, 0.5 = upright, 1 = tilted fully right.
Right hand closes into a fist (end = opens again).
Left hand closes into a fist (end = opens again).
Right hand shows an open palm.
Left hand shows an open palm.
Right hand goes up above the head.
Left hand goes up above the head.
Right thumb and index finger pinch together.
Left thumb and index finger pinch together.
Left hand gives a thumbs-up.
Head nods once.
Right hand makes a quick downward hit, like hitting a drum (wrist speed).
Left hand makes a quick downward hit, like hitting a drum (wrist speed).
Right hand grabs: an open palm held for a moment (about 0.15 s), then closed into a fist within about 0.6 s. Fires once; at most once a second. A thumbs-up never counts.
Left hand grabs: an open palm held for a moment (about 0.15 s), then closed into a fist within about 0.6 s. Fires once; at most once a second. A thumbs-up never counts.
How many fingers the left hand holds up (0 = fist, 1 = all five). raw is the count. The thumb counts only when it sticks out clearly from the hand.
How many fingers the right hand holds up (0 = fist, 1 = all five). raw is the count. The thumb counts only when it sticks out clearly from the hand.
How many fingers both hands hold up together (0 = none, 1 = all ten). raw is the count.
